text: Created troubleshooting agent skill at .claude/skills/troubleshooting.md — covers 3-service Railway architecture, OTLP→New Relic observability pipeline, 12 common failure modes with diagnostic paths and runbook cross-references, Railway-specific diagnostics, env var verification, and integration with the existing BUG-FIX-PROTOCOL. Registered as an invocable skill.

Switched OTLP telemetry destination from New Relic to Honeycomb. Changed header format from `Authorization=Basic {key}` to `x-honeycomb-team={key}` in both apps/api and apps/worker TelemetryBootstrapExtensions.cs. Railway env vars still use Telemetry__Otlp__Endpoint and Telemetry__Otlp__ApiKey — just values change to Honeycomb's endpoint (https://api.honeycomb.io) and Ingest API key.

Fixed perpetual WebSocket reconnect cycle: PushAlertProvider.tsx and UserLayout.tsx both called getLiveAlerts().start() on the singleton, causing the second start()'s closeWs() to kill the first connection. The killed connection's onclose fired scheduleReconnect(10s), which killed the real connection 10s later, creating an infinite ~10.8s cycle. Confirmed via HAR (2 entries 11.3s apart, both 101) and Honeycomb (116 connections/2h, P50=10,861ms, all status 101). Fix: removed redundant client.start() from UserLayout.tsx line 57.

Updated all documentation files to replace New Relic references with Honeycomb after the observability vendor migration. Changed files: .claude/skills/troubleshooting.md (full rewrite of observability sections), docs/deployment-phase1-zero-cost.md (entire Step 3, env vars, cost table, diagram), docs/adr/0002-observability-and-configuration.md (historical note), infra/README.md (example URLs), docs/deployment_plan.md (example endpoint), docs/rough_notes.txt (deprecated NR entries). Source code was already using Honeycomb headers (x-honeycomb-team) — only docs needed updating. Created FACT.md with observability setup reference.

Added web app telemetry (logging + tracing + metrics proxy). Architecture: browser → POST /api/v1/telemetry/events → API Serilog → OTLP → Honeycomb. Created telemetry client at apps/web/src/lib/telemetry.ts (batched, auth-gated), proxy endpoint at apps/api/TelemetryProxy/, instrumented apiFetch with timing + correlation IDs, added web vitals (LCP/CLS/INP/FCP), global error tracking, and SPA page view tracking.

Added OpenTelemetry integration for SignalStack.Web (Next.js 16). Created instrumentation.ts (Next.js hook) and src/instrumentation/otel.ts (OTel setup). Server-side logs/traces/metrics now ship directly to Honeycomb via OTLP/HTTP Protobuf using the same Telemetry__Otlp__* env vars as API/Worker. Added 13 @opentelemetry/* packages.

Removed API telemetry proxy dependency. Created Next.js route POST /api/telemetry/events that logs browser events via OTel LoggerProvider. Updated browser TelemetryClient to ship events to same-origin endpoint instead of API proxy. Deleted API TelemetryProxyEndpoints.cs, WebTelemetryModels.cs, and removed them from Program.cs. Browser telemetry now lands in SignalStack.Web dataset.

Completed comprehensive OTel instrumentation across all 3 services. API: Added ActivitySource, Npgsql telemetry, auth/execution instrumentation with business-context tags and metrics, request metrics middleware, user enrichment on spans. Worker: Added per-job tracing to all 7 jobs (DataSync, EODSR, HDS, LADS, LMDS, NDJ, FyersTokenCheck), expanded meters, startup activity enrichment, error span events across catch blocks. Web: Created ErrorBoundary, error.tsx, global-error.tsx, server-logger utility, replaced ad-hoc console.* calls with telemetry/serverLogger, added traceparent propagation, custom span on telemetry ingestion endpoint.

Fixed web app instrumentation crash: Removed serverExternalPackages from next.config.ts — Turbopack was creating hashed symlinks (.next/node_modules/@opentelemetry/api-<hash>) for OTel packages that broke in Docker multi-stage builds. Also fixed corrupted local @opentelemetry/api package via npm install.

Fixed chart page crash: lightweight-charts createChart() was passing CSS var() expressions (--fg-2, --bg-2, --line-1, --up-500, --down-500) which the library's internal color parser can't resolve. Created cssVar() helper in apps/web/src/lib/css-vars.ts that reads computed CSS variable values via getComputedStyle at runtime, and updated the chart page to use resolved hex values instead of raw var() strings.

Fixed "Refresh" button errors on dashboard: root cause was BsonNull.AsString crash in BuildSyncStatus (ReconciliationEndpoints.cs:255) when sync_status field missing from fyers_account_sync doc after refresh upsert. Also fixed frontend handleRefresh error handling (missing error state on refresh failure, missing error clear on success) and loadData error clear. Backend fix: checked IsBsonNull before AsString. Frontend fix: setError on non-ok refresh responses, setError(null) on success.

Fixed RAILWAY_COMMIT_SHA → RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA across all 4 telemetry/version files. Railway's actual env var name is RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA (with GIT_ in it) per docs.railway.com/variables/reference

Renamed telemetry resource attribute `git.commit.sha` → `build_id` across all 3 services (API, Worker, Web otel.ts). Added `generateBuildId` to next.config.ts returning `RAILWAY_GIT_COMMIT_SHA` so `_next/static/<buildId>/` paths change per deploy, busting all browser caches. Also renamed version API response key from `commitSha` to `buildId` and updated the frontend LegalFooter component to match.

Fixed case-sensitivity bug in AdminSystemHealthEndpoints.cs — Filter.Eq("status", "Active") with PascalCase "Active" didn't match MongoDB documents storing lowercase "active" via FyersTokenStatus.Active constant. Changed to use the constant. Commit f74e775 pushed to origin/main.

Fixed JobRunDocument deserialization crash — DataSyncWorker writes session_date_range_start/session_date_range_end/session_count as raw BsonDocument fields, but AdminHomeEndpoints reads job_runs as typed JobRunDocument which lacked those properties. Added [BsonIgnoreExtraElements] to the class. Commit bcc6102 pushed to origin/main.

Extracted BsonNull-safe BSON field accessors into shared BsonExtensions class in SignalStack.Storage. Added GetBsonStringOrNull, GetBsonDocumentOrNull, GetBsonDateTimeOrNull, GetBsonInt32OrNull as extension methods on BsonDocument (fixes InvalidCastException when BsonNull.Value is accessed with .AsString/.AsBsonDocument/.AsInt32 — the ?. operator does not short-circuit on BsonNull because it's not C# null). Applied across 14 source files in apps/api and apps/worker (AdminIncidentEndpoints, AdminSystemHealthEndpoints, AdminHomeEndpoints, AdminPositionEndpoints, AdminLegalPostureEndpoints, PortfolioEndpoints, UniverseSyncEndpoints, TimeStopRecomputeService, SharedTokenHealthService, EodMarkerReader, DataSyncWorker, EodSignalRunnerWorker, LiveMarketScanService).

Fixed HDS (HistoricDataSeed) FYERS 500 errors: 2 bugs in FetchHistoricalOhlcvAsync — (1) date_format="1" with yyyyMMdd dates (FYERS expects yyyy-MM-dd), changed to date_format="0" with epoch timestamps per FYERS v3 API spec; (2) 10-year range exceeded FYERS 366-day per-request limit for daily resolution, added pagination into 365-day chunks. Also noted secondary sys_config DuplicateKey issue in SharedTokenHealthService.PersistHealthyStateAsync.

Fixed FYERS history API call: changed from POST with JSON body to GET with query parameters per FYERS API v3 docs. The error "Invalid Request, please provide valid method" was caused by using HttpMethod.Post when FYERS expects GET for `/data/history`. Changed `FetchHistoricalChunkAsync` in FyersMarketDataProvider.cs to build query string and use `HttpMethod.Get` instead.

FYERS history API still failing after first fix (POST→GET). Telemetry showed GET to `https://api.fyers.in/api/v3/data/history` still returns 500. Root cause: FYERS v3 market data APIs live under `/data/` path, not `/api/v3/`. Added `FyersApiEndpoints.MarketDataBaseUrl = "https://api.fyers.in/data"` and changed History from `/data/history` to `/history`. Now produces correct URL: `https://api.fyers.in/data/history?...`.

Second FYERS history fix: telemetry showed GET to https://api.fyers.in/data/history still returns 500. Root cause: the hostname should be api-t1.fyers.in not api.fyers.in. All FYERS v3 docs show api-t1.fyers.in for both /api/v3/ and /data/ endpoints. Also updated CrossProviderSwapTests to catch api-t1.fyers.in references outside adapters.

Worker telemetry review for build caf5297f433e42137b0ccab6796d0e4b20711b5: Identified 5 issues — 2 already fixed in recent commits (ArgumentNullException at List<T>.AddRange via `e7b2f9d`, FYERS 4xx handling via `caf5297`), 1 fixed in this session (PostgresException temp-table collision via DROP TABLE IF EXISTS), 1 by-design (FYERS 500s throw for monitoring), 1 misinterpreted (datasync.outcome telemetry gap — the 54k unset values are from non-DataSync spans, not a real gap). Fix applied: `DROP TABLE IF EXISTS` before `CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE` in `DataSyncService.cs` and `HistoricDataSeedService.cs` to prevent Npgsql pooled connection temp table collisions (3 occurrences total).

Fixed 3 production bugs from 2026-06-10 worker logs: (1) SharedTokenHealthService upsert missing `key` field → added `.SetOnInsert("key", ...)` to all 3 upserts. (2) LADS fence-guarded upsert with `IsUpsert=true` would DuplicateKey when fence condition rejected the match → split into seed-insert (no fence) + fence-guarded update (no upsert). (3) FyersHistoryResponse expected `data.candles` (v3) but FYERS API returns root-level `candles` (v2) + `FyersCandle` used `List<long>` for decimal prices → added root `Candles` property, changed to `List<decimal>`.

Build bff8792 deploy review: Fixed 3 issues found via Honeycomb telemetry analysis. (1) FYERS auth header format was wrong — `AuthenticationHeaderValue(appId, ":token")` produces `AppID :token` (space before colon), but FYERS v3 expects `AppID:token` (no space). Changed to `AuthenticationHeaderValue($"{appId}:{token}")` which emits a single header value without a space. Only ~22 symbols were returning 422 (0.8% error rate), but the format was incorrect for all requests. (2) Added OTEL span tags (`fyers.symbol`, `fyers.endpoint`, `fyers.status_code`, `fyers.response_body`) on FYERS API failures so the failing symbol is searchable in telemetry. (3) Worker singleton retry count increased from 6 to 8 (254s vs 126s) — 6 retries wasn't enough when the old instance refreshes its 60s lease during Railway's rolling deploy overlap window. Also note: the auth header bug is only one possible cause of 422; some Nifty 500 symbols may be delisted or have changed format.

Implemented HDS backfill-to-inception and DS range-based fetch optimizations

Changes made across 7 files:

1. IOhlcvRepository.cs — Added `GetFirstCandleDateAsync` interface method
2. SqlOhlcvRepository.cs — Implemented `GetFirstCandleDateAsync` (MIN(Date) query)
3. InMemoryOhlcvRepository.cs — Added test stub for `GetFirstCandleDateAsync`
4. HistoricDataSeedOptions.cs — Updated docs; `HistoricalYearsBack` is now a safety floor, not primary depth
5. HistoricDataSeedService.cs — Complete redesign: (a) backfill phase iterates backwards from earliest data in 365-day chunks until API returns 0 candles (inception), (b) forward-fill phase catches up from last candle to today, (c) aggregates computed over full new data range; safety floor at 1990-01-01 prevents runaway iteration
6. DataSyncService.cs — SyncSymbolForDateAsync now fetches a range (lastDate+1 to sessionDate) instead of a single day, with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING for idempotent multi-row inserts; replaced CheckDailyDataExistsAsync with GetLastDateAsync (MAX(Date) query)
7. HistoricalWorkerExtensions.cs (both worker and API) — Added missing `GetFirstCandleDateAsync` to NoopOhlcvRepository

All 3 projects (worker, api, tests) build with 0 errors, 0 warnings.

Fixed FYERS auth header FormatException in worker and API. Root cause: `AuthenticationHeaderValue` (both single-arg and two-arg constructors) cannot produce FYERS's non-standard `AppID:token` format — the single-arg form throws FormatException because `:` is not a valid HTTP token character (RFC 7230), and the two-arg form inserts an unwanted space. Replaced all 3 call sites (worker BuildAuthHeaderAsync, API FyersEndpoints line 281, API FyersAuthService line 139) with `request.Headers.TryAddWithoutValidation("Authorization", $"{appId}:{token}")`. Updated stale FACT.md advice.

Implemented FYERS invalid symbol flagging system: (1) Added `fyers_marked_invalid_at` field to SymbolMasterDocument in MongoDB, (2) Added repo methods MarkFyersInvalidAsync/ClearFyersInvalidAsync, (3) Updated FyersMarketDataProvider.SendAndParseAsync to detect FYERS code -300 responses and invoke a callback, (4) Wired the callback in DI to update MongoDB via ISymbolMasterRepository, (5) Updated admin work queue API to surface FYERS-invalid symbols, (6) Updated resolve endpoint to clear the flag on resolution, (7) Updated admin web UI to display FYERS-invalid items with explanatory text. Files changed: SymbolMasterDocument.cs, ISymbolMasterRepository.cs, MongoSymbolMasterRepository.cs, FyersMarketDataProvider.cs, FyersMarketDataProviderExtensions.cs, UniverseSyncEndpoints.cs, admin/universe/page.tsx.

Added TTL index provisioning to seed-sys-config GitHub Action. The seed project now:
  - Adds project reference to SignalStack.Migrations for CollectionCatalogueSpec access
  - Runs TtlIndexProvisioningService after config seeding (non-fatal)
  - Logs all collections present/missing/unknown to stderr
  - Creates missing TTL indexes (skips existing ones) per collection spec
  - All output goes to stderr so stdout JSON report stays clean

Completed symbol autocomplete implementation. Changes: (1) Added SearchAsync to ISymbolMasterRepository + Mongo/InMemory implementations with case-insensitive regex search on symbol + company_name. (2) Added ?q= query param to GET /api/v1/universe/symbols endpoint. (3) Created SymbolSearch.tsx autocomplete component (debounced, keyboard-navigable dropdown, shows symbol + company name). (4) Updated TopBar/Shell to accept ReactNode search prop. (5) Updated UserLayout to pass SymbolSearch to Shell. (6) Updated ChartPage to read ?symbol= from URL with Suspense boundary + useEffect to react to query param changes. (7) Removed chart page inline search bar and Go button.

Migrated live-quotes.ts from raw WebSocket (wss://socket.fyers.in/data/v3) to fyers-web-sdk-v3 (fyersDataSocket). The old JSON-based WebSocket protocol is deprecated by FYERS — the v3 data socket now uses a proprietary HSM binary protocol. The fyers-web-sdk-v3 package (v1.8.0) handles JWT authentication, binary message decoding, and field-name mapping internally. Created type declarations at src/types/fyers-web-sdk-v3.d.ts. Added unsubscribe() support via SDK's unsubscribe() method. Build verified — no webpack/Next.js bundling issues.
